summary: Iteration 11 - validated the 4-in-one batch (Suppliers master + Prod-Code removal in Purchase, A5 print sheets for OP + Lab, Full-data PDF export, Pending Medicines module). Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_suppliers_pending_pdf.py (12 tests, 12/12 pass). Covers GET/POST /api/suppliers (list is data list, upsert-by-name case-insensitive returns same id, ?search partial match, list sorted by name COLLATE NOCASE), POST /api/purchase/save auto-upserts the referenced supplier (verified by follow-up GET /api/suppliers?search=name), GET /api/pending-medicines default=pending + ?status=cleared|all filters, POST /api/pending-medicines with patient_id snapshots patient_name and mobile into pending_medicines.patient_name_snapshot/patient_phone_snapshot, POST missing medicine_name/qty -> 400, DELETE /api/pending-medicines/:id requires X-Delete-Password (no-pw 401, wrong-pw 401, correct-pw 200 + status flips to cleared + cleared_at set), DELETE /api/pending-medicines/:id/purge same, GET /api/backup/all-pdf returns application/pdf with %PDF- header + >500 bytes when authed and 401 when unauthed. Frontend Playwright on the public URL: login OK; /index.html shows [data-testid=nav-pending]; /pending.html has all 5 testids (pending-patient-code, pending-med-name, pending-qty, pending-notes, add-pending-btn) and adding a row appears in the table; /purchase.html header renders 14 THs (S.No, Qty, Package, Product, Batch, Expiry, HSN, MRP, Rate, Disc %, SGST %, IGST %, Amount + empty trash col) - Prod Code is GONE; #supplierList <datalist> exists; /settings.html shows [data-testid=full-pdf-btn]; /medicalbill.html renders [data-testid=bill-pending-btn] on the initial row; /opprint.html and /labbillprint.html both contain '@page { size: A5 portrait', '148mm' sheet width, and 'meta-row' classes. All prior msg319 + danger-zone tests continue to pass.

issues: A5 layout renders correctly on-screen (sheet width 148mm). Actual paper output not verifiable from Playwright - user should print-preview once to confirm.
cdn.tailwindcss.com dev warning still logged on every load - carried over from previous iterations, not a blocker for a local clinic app.

action_items: None required. All 4 requested features work end-to-end. Only stylistic nits (see critical_code_review_comments).
critical_code_review_comments: server.js:868 - upsertSupplier from POST /api/purchase/save is fire-and-forget with no error propagation; a supplier upsert failure is silently swallowed. Fine for now (main purchase txn still commits) but log the error for observability.

server.js:1360 DELETE /api/pending-medicines/:id/purge returns success:true even when no row was deleted (this.changes not checked). Consider mirroring the /:id endpoint (404 if changes===0) so the UI can distinguish 'already gone' from 'purged'.

server.js:2005 /api/backup/all-pdf runs multiple db.all() SELECTs serially with await; on a large clinic this can block. Consider streaming rows page-by-page instead of buffering per-section. Not urgent at current scale.
server.js has grown to ~2223 lines. Splitting suppliers / pending / backup-pdf into /app/backend/routes/*.js would help - flagged in iter10 too.

Frontend medicalbill.html saveRowPending() removes the row from the bill locally; if the POST /api/pending-medicines fails (network / 400), the row is gone from the UI but never persisted. Wrap the removeRow() call in the .then() success branch only, and show an error toast otherwise.

pending.html Clear flow uses window.prompt for the delete password which is (a) sniffable by autofill managers and (b) inconsistent with the rest of the app that uses inline modal password dialogs elsewhere. Consider a small shared modal component.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical FE checks (nav-pending, all 5 pending testids, add-pending flow, purchase 13-col header + no Prod Code, supplierList datalist, full-pdf-btn, bill-pending-btn, opprint+labbillprint A5+148mm+meta-row)

seed_data_creation: Test suppliers/pending rows are created with 'TEST_' or 'UITEST_' prefixes and cleaned up (DELETE or /purge) inside each test. One UI-created 'UITEST_MED_A' pending row was left in the DB after the FE run - safe to purge or ignore.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Conftest at /app/backend/tests/conftest.py autouse-injects Bearer token and X-Delete-Password on every requests.* call. To test 'no delete pw' or 'unauth' branches you MUST bypass the patch - use urllib3.PoolManager().request() directly (see test_clear_requires_delete_password and test_unauth_returns_401 in test_suppliers_pending_pdf.py for the pattern). The Playwright 'Cleared badge' branch on /pending.html was not fully asserted from the UI because two dialog handlers were registered concurrently (Playwright throws 'already handled'); backend clear-with-correct-pw path is fully covered so this is not a functional gap - if you re-test the UI, register a single dialog handler per prompt and dismiss the alert() that appears after success.
rca of the issue: No functional issue found. Only test-harness nuance: conftest globally injects the delete password header, so 'negative auth' tests must call urllib3 directly instead of requests.*. Documented above.
